states_from_plan.EFFECTIVE: c > b AND p < 0.05 -> may state: B accepted more than A on this batch (n=18 pairs, 6 tasks x 3 reps), direction-consistent with the offline real-signal row (polyglot_py +9.7pp, n=68). May NOT state 'proves better' (one batch, one model, small n, H-12).
states_from_plan.CONTRADICTS: c < b AND p < 0.05 -> no effect claim in EITHER direction; investigate. 'the loop is harmful' is NOT a pre-registered conclusion (R532 AMEND1 direction guard: a significant result in the opposite direction has no pre-registered state and draws no harm conclusion).
states_from_plan.UNRESOLVED: otherwise (including c > b with p >= 0.05) -> record direction and magnitude only; a null here is not a negative result (n=18 is underpowered to detect +9.7pp).
states_from_plan.INCOMPLETE: round budget ended before rep 3 finished -> only completed reps reported descriptively; no decision state assigned; partial batch is neither clean nor dirty.

caveats: n=18 pairs is underpowered for a +9.7pp effect; UNRESOLVED is the expected-common outcome and is a legitimate state
single model, single slot, 6 tasks: does not transfer to another model/harness/budget/corpus without re-running (H-12)
v1 (3/6 vs 2/6) and v2 (4/6 vs 4/6) remain unregistered smoke evidence; this prereg does not retroactively cover them
